# 2 Baruch Chapter 81 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 81:2 — two ways witness formula

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "I-call-heaven-and-earth as-witnesses against-you this-day, that-you-have-chosen death-and-life" |
| LOGOS | "I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you this day, that you have chosen death and life" |
| PNEUMA | "Today I call heaven and earth as witnesses against you: that you have before you death and life" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. This verse echoes Deuteronomy 30:19 closely; LOGOS preserves the biblical resonance of the formula. PNEUMA's 'you have before you' softens the accusatory 'you have chosen' of the original.

---

## 81:4 — eternal kingdom doxology

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "his-kingdom endures-for-ever-and-ever" |
| LOGOS | "his kingdom endures forever and ever" |
| PNEUMA | "his kingdom goes on forever and ever" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Endures' (Syriac: qayem) implies standing firm/persisting; 'goes on' (PNEUMA) is more neutral and loses the solidity of the image.

---
